descriptionChirho: To cause someone to feel shame or disgrace, with the subject as the agent inflicting shame (1 Cor 1:27 God chose the foolish to shame the wise; 1 Cor 11:4-5 shames his/her head; Rom 5:5 hope does not put to shame; 1 Cor 11:22 you shame those who have nothing).

To experience shame or disgrace, with the subject as the one suffering shame (Rom 9:33, 10:11 whoever believes will not be put to shame; 1 Pet 2:6; 2 Cor 7:14 I was not put to shame; 2 Cor 9:4 we might be put to shame; 1 Pet 3:16 put to shame; Luke 13:17 adversaries ashamed).
